objective: Provide the native token-free continuous-state Hybrid with a deterministic, causal, action-branch comparison interface, from one identical past memory state, without ever writing hypothetical branches into its factual memory. Goal-conditioned selection is supplied explicitly, not learned. No changes to underlying model weights or training schedules.

scope.input_interface: continuous sensors [B,S] and candidate interventions [B,K,A], scalar per-batch positive real dt [B,1], supplied continuous sensor goal [B,S], optional exact native ContinuousState
scope.tie_rule: choose lowest candidate index when predicted squared target errors tie
scope.branch_semantics: Every candidate must be computed from the SAME immutable recurrent, fast-weight and historical state, with original native_model.step invoked in one batched tensor. Returned speculative model states discarded; no outcomes observed; zero memory learning. Return branch predictions [B,K,S] without changing input state.
scope.goal_decision: Per-candidate squared Euclidean distance between predicted continuous next sensor observation and explicitly SUPPLIED per-example continuous target. Minimize; do not claim the goal objective was learned.
scope.real_factual_update: Only after caller provides an actual observed next continuous sensor reading for ONE physically executed action, invoke existing model.step with original prior and then existing model.learn_outcome exactly once. No other branch writes. Caller is responsible for source authenticity; receipt must not label imagined outcomes factual.
scope.torch_autograd: No forced inference/no_grad; preserves differentiable branch estimates. Never update parameters during preview.
scope.science_limits: Engineering ONLY: no public source actions, no new training, no real-world control competence or general planning, autonomous reasoning, RSI, transfer, or improvement claims; must preserve P36 positives and stronger conventional controller.
